sources.title: UNLV Tuition+ Award Program | Financial Aid & Scholarships | UNLV
sources.quote: UNLV Tuition+ is a need-based scholarship for in-state undergraduate students. In conjunction with other UNLV scholarships and state and federal aid, it provides most eligible Nevada residents the equivalent of 12-15 credit hours of course fees each semester
